description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the class DittoAcknowledgementLabel, verifying immutability, equality, containment logic, and constant values.

classes.name: DittoAcknowledgementLabelTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DittoAcknowledgementLabel, testing immutability, equality, containment, and constant values.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that DittoAcknowledgementLabel class instances are immutable and also that AcknowledgementLabel is immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests the hashCode and equals methods of DittoAcknowledgementLabel, and compares a specific constant with an AcknowledgementLabel.

methods.name: containsNullIsFalse
methods.description: Ensures that the static contains method returns false when called with null.

methods.name: doesNotContainGivenLabel
methods.description: Checks that the contains method returns false for a label not matching any constant.

methods.name: containsConstantOfSelf
methods.description: Verifies that the class recognizes its own constants via the contains method.

methods.name: containsGivenLabel
methods.description: Tests the contains method with a label string matching a class constant.

methods.name: valuesReturnsAllConstantsInCorrectOrder
methods.description: Retrieves all declared constants of the class via reflection and verifies the values() method returns these constants.
